prompt: Please carry out an HSSM analysis of the frozen synthetic trials in data.csv; dataset_metadata.json describes how they were generated. I want a flat analytical drift-diffusion model with uncertainty on v, a, z and t, and an assessment of how well it reproduces reaction times and choices. Treat the condition column as a display label. Use the supplied HSSM 0.5.0 environment, no regressions or lapse mixture, 200 prior-predictive draws, and two MCMC chains with 1,000 tuning and 1,000 retained draws each, using one process and a fixed reported seed. Sampling and predictive generation are authorized for this scenario, but please use the supplied observations rather than generate a replacement dataset. Inspect the prior predictions before fitting. Save the analysis code, artifacts, and a Bayesian report with the evidence, uncertainty, and any unresolved concerns. Do not increase the sampling budget or change the seed to improve diagnostic results without asking.
assertions: Uses the supplied frozen CSV without regenerating, selectively removing or silently recoding observations; verifies its declared seconds units, -1/+1 response meaning, row count and the constant display-only condition
Constructs the supported HSSM 0.5.0 flat analytical DDM with no lapse mixture and records the actual dependency versions, fixed seed and requested inference budget

Specifies and inspects effective priors for v, a, z and t on their natural scales; explains the boundary convention and an explicit t support policy below the minimum retained RT, identifying any observed-data dependence

Executes the authorized native prior-predictive and sampling workflow, makes a substantive prior assessment and saves the returned posterior before downstream calculations; a plan alone does not satisfy this runtime scenario

Uses native HSSM posterior prediction and joint-trial log likelihood with supported arguments; preserves the original sample and trial coordinates and does not claim that the MCMC seed alone makes HSSM 0.5.0 posterior predictions reproducible

Verifies complete, correctly parameterized scalar prior densities before sensitivity, including sample-coordinate compatibility with the pinned HSSM/PyMC APIs; retains failed checks rather than silently relabeling or bypassing them

Retains the authoritative RT/choice pair and one joint likelihood value per original trial; any scalar RT and response==+1 calibration views keep the component mapping and sample/trial axes, omit joint likelihood and use fitted-data marginal PPC-PIT

Assesses choice proportions and RT distributions conditional on each response, including sparse or absent-choice replicates; does not infer joint, conditional or held-out calibration from two marginal assessments

Uses the shared Bayesian assessment implementation for available convergence, LOO, sensitivity and calibration evidence, preserving poor or unavailable results and translating next steps into actions appropriate to this DDM

Writes the canonical report with actual saved figures and numerical evidence, records unresolved software or statistical failures, and does not require every interval to contain generating truth or present a single synthetic dataset as parameter recovery
